unitAssumption: 1 world unit ≈ 1 metre (CELL=4 m tiles, playable y ∈ [0.65, 7.1])

notes: Ambient pressure ≈ 1 + depth_m/10 ATA; gas use scales roughly with ATA.
Neutral buoyancy + BCD control dominate vertical motion; divers do not fly with equal XYZ thrust.
Water drag is roughly quadratic; free coast after stopping kick is short.

verdicts.swimSpeed: ARCADE — cruise ~6–11× recreational finning; sprint exceeds elite finswim.
verdicts.gasModel: COMPRESSED — 4 min flat timer; no depth/exertion scaling (Boyle / SAC omitted).
verdicts.buoyancy: OMITTED — free 6DOF flight with identical vertical/horizontal thrust; no weight/BCD.
verdicts.dragCoast: PLAUSIBLE ORDER — ~0.7 m coast from cruise with τ=0.25 s (arcade-responsive).
verdicts.depthScale: SHALLOW CAVE — ~6.5 m playable y band; torch murk is stylistic, not optical attenuation law.
verdicts.depthHud: THEATRICAL — reads ~17 m at start and ~42 m at the relic while collision y spans only ~6.5 m; −Z progress inflates the gauge.
verdicts.predatorPacing: DESIGNED CHASE — chase 3.4 m/s beats cruise 2.8, loses to sprint 4.8 (~5.4 s stamina).
verdicts.overall: Gameplay-first survival pacing, not a scuba physics simulator.
